name: TurretGuard
tagline: An autonomous turret that detects drowning on camera and launches a buoy to the swimmer.
problem: Drowning kills many people within sight of help but too far for a fast rescue; the team cites a global annual figure.
solution: A custom-trained model classifies drowning behaviour from a live camera; a PID controller aims a 3D-printed turret using projectile motion, and it fires an inflatable buoy.
demo_moment: Team-described: simulate a struggling swimmer and watch the turret aim and launch.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Hack the 6ix: 1st Place” and “Hack the 6ix: Best Hardware Hack” among 131 submissions.
Trained its own detection model and reported its confidence curve.
Won first place and best hardware: a physical rescue device with life-or-death stakes.

lessons: Pair a dramatic physical action with evidence the model works (metrics on screen).
